question: Could the project track "2nd/3rd/4th-string backups replacing starters" from official NFL sources?
answer: No. Verified on 2026-11-14: nfl.com publishes no depth chart (AV-1, AV-2) and no snap/share data (AV-4, AV-5). Only position and roster status (AV-3) plus injury/participation status (AV-6) are official.
consequence: Any 2nd/3rd/4th-string claim would have to come from a non-official source. Under this project's own rule (never infer, blank if unconfirmed) those fields MUST stay blank and be flagged, not estimated.
what_would_unblock_it: An official, retrievable, timestamped depth chart (team-controlled or league-controlled) with a stable URL -- NOT FOUND as of 2026-11-14.
Official per-game participation counts (snaps) -- NOT FOUND in the nfl.com stats taxonomy.
Operator-declared inactives list ~90 minutes pre-kickoff -- the only official pre-game availability signal observed; see AV-6 for practice/game status.

probe.observed: Page renders "404 - Flag on the Play."
probe.meaning: nfl.com does not publish a league-wide depth chart.

probe.observed: Page renders "404 - Flag on the Play."
probe.meaning: A club-level depth chart URL does not exist on nfl.com either; the URL pattern is not valid.

probe.observed: Roster table with columns: player, number, POSITION, roster status (ACT), height, weight, experience, college.
probe.meaning: Positions and roster status are official; there is NO ordering, NO "starter/2nd/3rd/4th string" field.

probe.observed: Page renders "404 - Flag on the Play."
probe.meaning: Snap-count categories are not part of the official player-stats taxonomy; a snap-share proxy cannot be built from nfl.com.

probe.observed: Official categories listed: Passing, Rushing, Receiving, Fumbles, Tackles, Interceptions, Field Goals, Kickoffs, Kickoff Returns, Punting, Punt Returns.
probe.meaning: No snap counts, no routes run, no target share, no alignment data. Starter-vs-backup usage cannot be derived from this taxonomy.

probe.observed: Per-player rows with POSITION, Injuries, Practice Status, Game Status; blank cells where the club designation is blank.
probe.meaning: Injury availability IS official and current. It does not say which string a player is.
